original_question: Let (X, g) be a compact Kahler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, and assume the invariant ntf(X, g), defined using truly flat tangent vectors, equals dim X. Must h^0(X, Omega_X^q) vanish for every q > 0, and is X automatically projective?
target_in_paper: Section 3, Problem 3.3 ([39, Problem 5.1]): for a compact Kähler manifold (X, g) with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature and ntf(X, g) = dim X, ask whether h^0(X, Ω_X^q) = 0 for every q > 0 and whether X is automatically projective.
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper's actual target very closely. It has the correct ambient setting (a compact Kähler manifold with a Kähler metric of semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature), the correct invariant ntf(X, g), the correct extremal hypothesis ntf(X, g) = dim X, and the exact two questions asked in the paper: vanishing of holomorphic q-forms for q > 0 and automatic projectivity.
missing_details: State explicitly that X is a compact complex Kähler manifold and g is a Kähler metric on X.
Spell out semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature as HSC_g(v) >= 0 for every nonzero tangent vector v.
Give the exact definition ntf(X, g) := dim X - inf_{p in X} dim V_flat,p.
Define V_flat,p as the subspace of T_{X,p} consisting of truly flat tangent vectors.
Define 'truly flat' precisely: v in T_{X,p} satisfies R_g(v, x, y, z-bar) = 0 for all x, y, z in T_{X,p}.
Clarify that h^0(X, Ω_X^q) means dim_C H^0(X, Ω_X^q), or equivalently replace it by the stand-alone statement H^0(X, Ω_X^q) = 0.
Specify the quantifier on q as all integers q with 1 <= q <= dim X (equivalently q > 0).
Clarify that 'projective' means X is biholomorphic to a smooth complex projective variety.
refined_question: Let X be a compact complex Kähler manifold, and let g be a Kähler metric on X whose holomorphic sectional curvature is semi-positive, i.e. HSC_g(v) >= 0 for every nonzero v in T_{X,p} and every p in X. For each p in X, let V_flat,p := {v in T_{X,p} : R_g(v, x, y, z-bar) = 0 for all x, y, z in T_{X,p}}, and define ntf(X, g) := dim X - inf_{p in X} dim V_flat,p. If ntf(X, g) = dim X, must H^0(X, Ω_X^q) = 0 for every integer q with 1 <= q <= dim X, and is X necessarily projective?
justification: The paper's nearest official formulation is exactly Problem 3.3 in Section 3. The surrounding text first defines ntf(X, g) and truly flat tangent vectors, then recalls Theorem 3.2 for the projective case, and immediately after that states the two-part open problem asking whether, under ntf(X, g) = dim X for a compact Kähler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, one has h^0(X, Ω_X^q) = 0 for all q > 0 and whether X is automatically projective. Your draft is therefore essentially paper-faithful already; the only real gaps are the precise curvature-tensor definition of truly flat vectors, the exact formula for ntf(X, g), and clarification of the q-quantifier and h^0 notation.
